hero.title: A trauma-informed public platform for DHRC growth and trust.
hero.lead: The DHRC Master Blueprint 3.0 website is designed to communicate mission, services, and community commitment clearly while keeping sensitive information protected and public-facing content easy to manage.
commitments: No fake claims or sensitive data

about.heading: A mission-driven website foundation for a safer, more visible DHRC presence.
about.body: This site is structured to help DHRC present its values, purpose, and public programmes with clarity and professionalism. It is built to be launch-ready, easy to edit, and suitable for a free hosting workflow while protecting confidential and survivor-sensitive information from public exposure.

programs.heading: Service areas and public information pillars

items.title: Prevention and awareness
items.description: Educational resources and public messaging that raise awareness in a respectful, trauma-informed way.

items.title: Case support pathways
items.description: Clear referral and support guidance while keeping confidential care channels separate from public content.

items.title: Community engagement
items.description: A public-facing platform for partners, volunteers, and supporters to understand the mission and next steps.

items.title: Capacity building
items.description: Future-ready information architecture designed to support grants, partnerships, and operational scaling.

steps.title: Define the public message
steps.text: Keep the website focused on verified mission and public-facing information only. Avoid publishing confidential survivor details or sensitive operational claims.

steps.title: Build a resilient structure
steps.text: Create content blocks, reusable sections, and clear navigation so updates remain fast and simple without affecting core functionality.

steps.title: Prepare for launch
steps.text: Use a free hosting workflow, connect the domain later, and keep advanced secure services behind a separate protected layer.

items.title: Public information hub
items.description: A central area for information about DHRC, service intentions, and public engagement opportunities.

items.title: Referral guidance
items.description: Public contact pathways that are clear, accountable, and designed with privacy-first principles.

items.title: Content governance
items.description: A simple edit model so team members can update text and sections without technical complexity.

contact.heading: Start the next phase with a trusted public launch
contact.subheading: Use this form as a simple placeholder for enquiries. Replace the mailto destination and any contact details with verified DHRC information later.
